name: Kisvárda (Hungary)
description: A vertical green banner with a red triangle descending from the top edge to a point near the bottom, charged in the triangle with the town arms of Kisvárda (a red, white and green shield with a dragon) below the name KISVÁRDA in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: inverted triangle from the top edge
